title: Replicate API token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one body character replaced by '.', a non-word byte no source admits (only '-' and '_' are contested). Twin of "Replicate API token: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
